name: Letter to Jorgen
summary: In Stormwind City, a sealed letter calls Jorgen to help find a missing diplomat.

sections.title: A Dispassionate Summons
sections.body: A diplomat bound for Theramore never arrived for talks with Lady Jaina Proudmoore. Royal investigators moved quickly to keep the matter quiet. While official agents searched the capital, other channels stirred. The letter bypasses military ranks and seeks Jorgen, a gruff veteran who fishes beneath the great statues in the Valley of Heroes. It invokes old obligations and draws him into a covert inquiry amid rumors of a Defias conspiracy.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this letter?
aliases: what does letter to jorgen do
faq.answer: The letter introduces its bearer and calls on Jorgen to honor an old obligation. It sends the bearer to the Valley of Heroes to help investigate the missing diplomat quietly.
Jorgen is a reclusive contact just inside Stormwind's gates who spends his time fishing in the Valley of Heroes. He dislikes interruptions, but an old debt binds him to help when shown the letter.

faq.q: What disappearance does the letter relate to?
faq.answer: A prominent diplomat left Stormwind by ship for Theramore to meet Lady Jaina Proudmoore, then vanished along the way. Suspicion falls on the Defias Brotherhood, though the full plot remains closely guarded.

aliases: where do i take the letter
faq.answer: The letter is carried to the Valley of Heroes, Stormwind City's grand entrance lined with monuments to the heroes of the Second War. Jorgen fishes by the water near the front gates.

angles.text: The letter concerns the Alliance's fragile stability and seeks a quiet response to an incident that threatens ties between Stormwind and Theramore.
As a rogue, you know that quiet dispatches and reluctant street informants can help uncover trouble in the capital.
